What NDT inspection management software actually has to do

NDT inspection management software has to run the whole job, not just produce the report. For an NDT service company, that means one system that carries a job from the first enquiry through the quote, crew dispatch, field data capture, Level II or Level III review, and the invoice, without anyone retyping the same job number, site and method five times.

Most inspection companies in the USA and Canada grew into their tools rather than choosing them. The quote lives in a Word template, the schedule lives on a whiteboard or a shared calendar, technician certs live in a spreadsheet the QA manager updates when they remember, field data comes back on paper or as phone photos, the report gets built in Excel, and the invoice gets built again in the accounting package. Each hand-off is a place where the wrong procedure revision, an expired cert or a missed billable day slips through.

The Atlantis ERP solution was built by an ASNT NDT Level III for exactly this workflow. It is a fully customized ERP for NDT and inspection companies: the NDT-specific apps (reports, certificates, procedures, team assignments, equipment) sit next to CRM, quotations, project, timesheets and invoicing, so each step reads from the step before it. Below is how that loop works in practice, step by step, and where it differs from a generic ERP or a stand-alone reporting tool.

NDT inspection software from job intake to invoice: the full loop

The short answer: every job is one record that moves through six stages, and each stage adds data instead of copying it. Here is the loop as it runs in the Atlantis ERP apps.

  1. Intake in CRM: the enquiry is logged with service line, NDT service type, industry sector, site country, and the estimated number of technicians and days.
  2. Quote in Quotations: job type, site, project dates and applicable codes go on a branded quote the client can accept and sign online; acceptance converts it to a sales order.
  3. Plan in Project: client PO, contract, methods, codes, scope, acceptance criteria, safety induction and work permit fields.
  4. Dispatch in Team Assignments: technicians and serial-numbered equipment are assigned, with double-booking and out-of-calibration checks.
  5. Capture and report in NDT Reports and the offline field app: method-specific data, photos and signatures, then review and approval.
  6. Bill in Timesheets and Invoicing: approved billable hours, equipment and consumables become invoice lines against the job and PO.

The sections below walk through each stage with the detail an operations manager or QA/QC manager will actually care about.

Stage 1: job intake that captures what the scheduler needs

A good intake record answers the questions your scheduler will ask on Monday morning: which method, which site, how many technicians, how many days, and for which industry. The Atlantis CRM holds those as fields on the lead rather than as free text in an email thread.

Leads can be imported from CSV, scored from 0 to 100 (hot, warm, nurture, cold) using NDT-specific inputs, and enrolled in a drip email sequence by service line if the buyer is not ready yet. Business cards collected at a trade show or a plant turnaround kickoff can be photographed; the name, company, title, email, phones and website are extracted and turned into a CRM lead in one click. Enquiry forms on your company website feed the same CRM, so a request for a phased array crew at a Gulf Coast refinery does not sit in a general inbox for three days.

For a small NDT company, the practical value here is simple: the owner and the operations lead see the same pipeline, and nobody quotes a job the crew calendar cannot cover.

Stage 2: NDT quoting that matches how inspection work is sold

NDT quoting software needs to price labour, equipment and consumables separately and reference the codes the client cares about. The Atlantis quotation carries job type, site, project dates and applicable codes, with NDT service products flagged by method and category, and an optional global discount.

The quote prints on your own branded PDF layout, and the client can accept and sign it online. Acceptance converts the quote into a sales order, which becomes the anchor for the project, the dispatch and, later, the invoice. That single thread is what lets you answer the question every inspection company owner eventually asks: did we make money on this job?

Your rate structures, day rates versus hourly, standby, travel, overtime multipliers and per diems are set up during implementation to match how you already sell. We do not force a pricing model on you; the software records whatever commercial terms you agree with the client.

If you want to see a quote go from draft to signed sales order with your own service list, book a quote-to-invoice walkthrough.

Stage 3: crew dispatch and scheduling software for NDT crews

Crew dispatch for NDT is a qualification problem as much as a calendar problem. The right person is the one who is available, holds a current certification in the method, and has calibrated equipment to take to site. The Atlantis Team Assignments app checks all three.

Each job is a team assignment that moves through planned, dispatched, in field, submitted and closed. It records site GPS coordinates and mobilisation and demobilisation dates. The technician availability calendar holds assigned, leave, training, sick and unavailable days, and overlaps are blocked. Double-booking of a technician or of an equipment serial number is blocked, so two crews cannot both be promised the same PAUT unit for the same week. If the equipment you assign is out of calibration, the dispatcher gets a warning before the crew leaves the yard.

Dispatchers work from calendar, kanban and list views, and each technician shows current assignment, utilisation and next available date. Time Off requests feed the same availability calendar, so approved leave is not something the scheduler has to remember separately.

If your crews move radioactive sources for industrial radiography, the Fleet app records whether a vehicle can carry sources, its transport licence number and expiry, and which job and driver it is assigned to. Your NRC or Agreement State licensing obligations stay yours, but the vehicle side of the evidence sits in the same system.

Stage 4: field capture that works with no signal

Offline capability is non-negotiable for NDT inspection software. Tank farms, pipe racks, vessel internals, offshore modules and remote pipeline right-of-way in West Texas or northern Alberta do not have reliable coverage.

The Atlantis field app is an installable web app. It works without signal, stores drafts and photos locally on the device, and syncs when the technician is back in coverage. The technician picks the method, captures photos, signs on screen and previews the PDF before submitting. Through the REST API for field devices, the technician sees the jobs assigned to them and the equipment issued to them, so the report is started against the right job and the right instrument serial.

The data captured is method-specific, not a generic form. UT reports carry a probe calibration table. RT records source, technique, IQI type and placement. MT records technique and particle type; PT records method and developer. PAUT holds focal laws; MFL holds scan mode and item lines; UT thickness readings are recorded by direction. Weld and job lines carry defect type and orientation, and every report ends with an overall result: acceptable, not acceptable, or acceptable with remarks.

There are 17 report types in total, each with its own numbering sequence: UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, ECT, IRIS, PAUT, MFL, TOFD, PWHT, PMI, hardness, UT thickness, ferrite, holiday/coating and computed radiography.

Stage 5: report review, sign-off and delivery

Review and sign-off is where most report errors either get caught or get shipped to the client. The Atlantis NDT Reports workflow runs draft, in progress, review, approved, sent, with an inspector, a reviewer and an approver, each with a signature. Where a client or code requires it, the third-party inspector or authorized inspector name and signature are captured on the same report.

Each report carries its references: work order, request, WPS, contract, drawing numbers, and the procedure and standard it was performed to. That matters when a client auditor asks which revision of your UT procedure a weld was examined against; the answer is on the report, and the procedure register holds the approved revision.

Output uses your own versioned company templates in Excel, Word, PDF or HTML, with logo, header and footer. If your clients insist on their own Excel format, fields are mapped to cells and the template fills automatically, which removes the copy-paste stage entirely. PDF output is generated per method.

For marine work, a marine mode adds a vessel cover page and photo, inspection location and dates, and the PDF merges the classification-society certificate (DNV, ABS, Lloyd's Register, BV, RINA, IRS or ClassNK), the inspector's Level II certificate and the calibration certificate, with inspection photos laid out two to a row. One document goes to the surveyor instead of four attachments.

Stage 6: invoicing from what actually happened in the field

Invoicing should come from approved field time, not from the project manager's memory at month end. In the Atlantis ERP, timesheets record work type (inspection, travel, standby, setup), method, billable flag, rate multiplier, site, client and equipment serial, and go through approval. The timesheet warns when a technician's certificate is not valid, which is a useful last check before you bill a client for work done by someone whose cert lapsed.

The invoice header holds the NDT project, job or PO number, site, invoice type and industry sector, with subtotals for labour, equipment and consumables. Lines carry cost centre, method, equipment serial, technician, rate type, and days or hours. Field expenses and per diems recorded in Expenses can be re-billed to the job. The invoice layout is customised to your company.

The financial dashboard then shows revenue, cost of sales, gross margin, operating expenses, EBITDA, outstanding invoices, bills and expenses over a 12-month view. Payments, reminders and taxes are configured per country during implementation, which covers US state sales tax setups and Canadian GST/HST arrangements as your accountant specifies them.

Inspection management software for NDT companies: the compliance layer underneath

Running jobs end to end only works if the compliance data underneath is current. In the Atlantis ERP, three apps keep it current without a separate spreadsheet.

Certificates track each technician's scheme (SNT-TC-1A, CP-189, ISO 9712, PCN, CSWIP or other), level, method, certifying body, issue, expiry and renewal dates, OJT hours, training hours and exam results. Status is computed automatically as active, expiring soon (90 days), expired or revoked. Vision tests are recorded with near vision (Jaeger J1/J2), far vision, colour perception and contrast results. Daily checks create warning tasks 90 days before a cert or vision test expires, and email alerts go to the people you choose.

Asset Management tracks every instrument and probe by serial number, with issue and return approvals, condition at issue and return, reservations with clash prevention, maintenance logs, and calibration records including provider, certificate number, standard, range, uncertainty, accredited-lab flag, result and next due date.

Procedures hold your procedure register with document number, revision, method, scope, material, applicable standard such as ASME Section V, and acceptance criteria, through a draft, submitted, reviewed, approved, published workflow with locked approved revisions and full revision history.

Is this the best NDT inspection software for small NDT companies?

For a small NDT company, the best NDT inspection software is the one your technicians will actually use in the field and your office will not have to work around. That usually means fewer systems, not more. A five-technician UT and MT outfit in Louisiana does not need a platform built for a global integrity consultancy; it needs certs, calibration, dispatch, reports and invoices in one place.

The Atlantis ERP is affordable, accessible and fully customizable. You start with the apps you need, typically reports, certificates, team assignments, asset management, quotations and invoicing, and add CRM, fleet, eLearning or dashboards later. Pricing is quote on request, because it depends on which apps you use and how much configuration your templates and workflows need.

Larger contractors running multiple crews across Texas, Oklahoma, the Midwest and Alberta use the same apps with more cost centres, more dashboards and integrations to their existing finance or maintenance systems. The open REST API connects to SAP, Maximo, NetSuite, QuickBooks or any system that accepts API connections, scoped per implementation.

If you are weighing whether to move off spreadsheets this year, talk to us about your crew size and current tools and we will tell you plainly which apps are worth starting with.

How implementation works

Implementation is done by Atlantis NDT, not handed to a generic reseller. The work is mostly about your data and your documents: loading technicians and their certifications, loading your instrument list with serial numbers and calibration due dates, importing your procedure register, and building your report templates so the PDFs look like the reports your clients already accept.

We then configure the parts that differ between companies: rate types and multipliers, cost centres, invoice layout, tax setup, alert recipients and look-ahead days, and which roles can review and approve reports. Anything your workflow needs that is not a built-in feature is configured during implementation and agreed up front.

For training your own people, the eLearning app hosts Level I, II and III course sections with video lessons, quizzes and completion certificates, and connects to the Practical NDT 3D simulator. Atlantis offers ASNT SNT-TC-1A-based NDT training; the ERP can record certificates from other schemes your technicians hold.

If your clients want inspection results in 3D, the Atlantis Digital Twins platform and Digital Twin Reporting Software can present the same inspection data against a model of the asset.

Frequently asked questions

What is NDT inspection management software?

It is software that runs an NDT company's inspection operations in one place: enquiries, quotes, crew dispatch, field data capture, report review and sign-off, and invoicing, with technician certifications, equipment calibration and procedures tracked underneath. The Atlantis ERP covers that full loop.

Does the field app work offline?

Yes. It is an installable web app that stores drafts and photos on the device when there is no signal and syncs later. Technicians can pick the method, capture photos, sign on screen and preview the PDF offline.

Which NDT methods are supported in reports?

Seventeen report types: UT, RT, MT, PT, VT, ECT, IRIS, PAUT, MFL, TOFD, PWHT, PMI, hardness, UT thickness, ferrite, holiday/coating and computed radiography, each with its own numbering sequence and method-specific fields.

Can it stop us sending a technician with an expired cert or uncalibrated equipment?

It warns you. Certificate status is computed automatically with 90-day warnings, timesheets flag technicians whose certificate is not valid, and dispatch warns when assigned equipment is out of calibration. Double-booking of technicians and equipment serials is blocked.

Can we keep our clients' report formats?

Yes. Versioned company templates in Excel, Word, PDF or HTML are supported, and Excel templates fill automatically by mapping fields to cells.

Does it connect to our accounting or maintenance system?

The Atlantis ERP has an open REST API and integrates with SAP, Maximo, NetSuite, QuickBooks or any system that accepts API connections. The scope of each integration is agreed during implementation.

How much does it cost?

Quote on request. It depends on which apps you use and how much configuration is needed. Request a quote and a demo and we will scope it with you.
